description: Recognition core for M2 tasks 2.2 + 2.3: the stable FormulaRecognizer Protocol + shared RecognitionStatus, the typed pipeline.yaml config, the pix2tex adapter running REAL CPU inference on local-weights-only (pix2tex auto-downloader suppressed), the id->ctor factory with typed errors, the KaTeX-supported-macro allow-list generator + LaTeX validate/normalize, and LaTeX->MathML. Satisfies task 2.2 done (real image->LaTeX unit test on a committed fixture, no mocks) and task 2.3 done (invalid flagged, valid passes, golden). Design: m2-design.md §B.3, §B.4, §B.6, §B.9. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/context.json + FEAT-001.findings + this file FIRST, then m2-design.md §B.3/§B.4/§B.6/§B.9 and tasks.md 2.2/2.3. Use the real pix2tex version/tag/asset filenames FEAT-001 recorded.

Create recognizers/base.py (design §B.4): RecognitionStatus StrEnum (ok/needs_review/failed — the single shared state); RegionContext (is_display documented passthrough, device, source); FormulaResult (Pydantic: latex, confidence 0..1, confidence_kind, status, engine_id, detail — never a fabricated guess); @runtime_checkable FormulaRecognizer Protocol (id: str, model_ids: tuple[str,...], recognize(image, ctx) -> FormulaResult). recognizers/__init__.py exports them.

Create pipeline_config.py (design §B.4): PipelineConfig/Stages/RecognizeStage (recognize is a MAP of sub-stages formula/text/table/handwriting) + load_pipeline_config() parsing pipeline.yaml via Pydantic. Replace the ENTIRE commented placeholder body of pipeline.yaml (every #-commented line incl. # version: 1) with the real minimal config setting stages.recognize.formula: pix2tex, keeping the permissive-first comment; do not leave old commented lines beside the new block.

Create recognizers/formula_pix2tex.py (design §B.3): id='pix2tex', model_ids=('pix2tex',); construct pix2tex pointed ONLY at registry-resolved local checkpoint/resizer paths so pix2tex's built-in downloader is NEVER triggered (raise ModelNotReady if a weight file is absent). recognize() is pure, catches its own inference errors -> status=FAILED with detail (never raises). Confidence: probe the pinned pix2tex for per-token scores and record the outcome in docs/m2-verification.md; if reachable confidence=exp(mean token logprob) + confidence_kind='token_logprob', else confidence=0.0 + confidence_kind='unavailable' with a detail — NEVER fabricate a number.

HOST GATE: this downloads the model (user-approved) and runs REAL inference on this CPU host. If pix2tex genuinely cannot run on this host, STOP and send a warning (severity warning) describing the blocker — never mock or fake. Commit a small REAL formula-image fixture under engine/tests/fixtures/.

Create recognizers/factory.py (design §B.4): _REGISTRY keyed by adapter id; UnknownEngineError + FormulaStageNotConfigured; build_formula_recognizer(settings, model_registry) reads load_pipeline_config().stages.recognize.formula, raises FormulaStageNotConfigured when None, UnknownEngineError(stage_id, known) (logged, never a bare KeyError) when unregistered, resolves weights via ctor.model_ids[0] -> require_ready, passes explicit local weight paths.

Create scripts/gen_katex_allowlist.py (design §B.6): derive supported command/environment names from the pinned katex@0.16.11 — primary input the installed package public function registry (katex.mjs); verified fallback the vendored pinned katex SOURCE tarball (devDependency-only; record its SHA-256). Confirm the real input path against the installed katex and record it in docs/m2-verification.md. Write engine/texora_engine/ensemble/katex_allowlist.json with a header recording the katex version. (katex is added to apps/desktop/package.json here or by FEAT-005 if not yet present — add it here so the generator has an input; add its docs/LICENSES.md row.)

Create ensemble/latex.py (design §B.6): validate_and_normalize(latex) -> tuple[str, RecognitionStatus] — parse with pylatexenc LatexWalker; structurally check balanced {}, matched \left/\right, matched \begin{env}/\end{env}; check every command/env against the loaded allow-list (outside the set -> needs_review; parse/structure failure -> failed); normalize (canonical \frac, spacing, \operatorname/\mathrm) such that normalized output still validates. ensemble/__init__.py exports it.
Create export/mathml.py (design §B.9): convert validated LaTeX -> MathML via latex2mathml. NO asciimath.py and NO OMML/XSLT in M2 (deferred to M6). export/__init__.py exports it.

Write engine tests: test_recognizers_base.py (RecognitionStatus values + FormulaResult confidence bound); test_pipeline_config.py (stages.recognize.formula == 'pix2tex'); test_factory.py (pix2tex registered + isinstance(adapter, FormulaRecognizer) AC-3; unknown id -> UnknownEngineError with ids AC-3a; None key -> FormulaStageNotConfigured); test_formula_pix2tex.py (REAL-model fixture -> non-empty LaTeX via the production path AC-4, pytest.skip with an explicit reason if weights absent — NEVER mocked; a second test: constructing with weights absent raises ModelNotReady and makes NO network call, networking stubbed to fail); test_katex_allowlist.py (JSON recorded version == katex pin in apps/desktop/package.json); test_latex.py (golden: invalid cases flagged needs_review/failed, valid pass, each normalization rule's output still validates — AC-5 engine side); test_mathml.py (golden fixture LaTeX -> expected MathML).

Run the engine gate; run the benchmark smoke per steering now that the real model is fetched (OCR-affecting). Append output + the confidence-branch outcome + the katex allow-list input path to docs/m2-verification.md. Commit locally (conventional-commit), NEVER push. Set status completed; note in findings the confidence branch chosen and the adapter/factory API shapes FEAT-003 will call.
acceptance_criteria: FormulaRecognizer is a runtime_checkable Protocol with id + model_ids + recognize; the pix2tex adapter is an instance and is registered in the factory keyed by its id (test_factory.py AC-3).

The factory raises typed UnknownEngineError (carrying offending + known ids) for an unknown pipeline.yaml id and FormulaStageNotConfigured for an absent/None key — no bare KeyError, no silent default (AC-3a).

The pix2tex adapter converts a committed formula-image fixture to a non-empty, KaTeX-valid LaTeX string via the REAL model on the production path (test_formula_pix2tex.py AC-4; skipped-with-reason if weights absent, never mocked).
Constructing the adapter with weights absent raises ModelNotReady and makes NO network call (networking stubbed to fail).

The LaTeX validator flags unbalanced braces / mismatched \left\right / bad environments / out-of-allow-list macros as needs_review/failed; valid LaTeX passes; normalization output still validates; the allow-list JSON version matches the katex pin (test_latex.py + test_katex_allowlist.py — AC-5 engine side).
pipeline.yaml's placeholder body is fully replaced with the real recognize.formula: pix2tex config (permissive-first comment kept) and loads via Pydantic.
verification: From engine/ with the venv python and the PATH export: ruff check . ; black --check . --line-length 100 ; mypy texora_engine ; pytest -q — green (the real-model test runs with prefetched weights, else skips-with-reason).
Benchmark smoke per steering passes with the real model fetched.
